details: The conflict between the US and Iran has intensified with the US launching a fourth consecutive day of strikes, prompting Iran's deputy foreign minister to declare the interim peace deal "dismantled" and the nation engaged in an "existential war". In response, Iran has threatened to halt all Middle East energy exports amid a renewed US blockade. This escalation has led to a jump in oil prices, increasing the likelihood of interest rate hikes globally.
title: US-Iran Conflict Intensifies, Iran Threatens Energy Halt

details: Andrew Bailey, Governor of the Bank of England, stated he would have reconsidered a meeting with Reform UK leader Nigel Farage if he had been aware of a £5 million gift under investigation. The meeting involved discussions on cryptocurrency regulation. This comes amidst calls from some Labour MPs for a "total crypto ban" in the UK, highlighting growing scrutiny over digital asset regulation and political funding.
title: Bank of England Governor Addresses Farage Crypto Funding
